devdoc.details: Router contract for the BIFKN314 protocol that handles swapping and liquidity operations between ERC314 tokens and AVAX. Implements various swap functions and helper methods to facilitate trading in the BIFKN314 ecosystem.

TokenCacheInvalidated(address).details: Indicates that any previously stored mapping from the token to an ERC-314 contract      should no longer be trusted and consumers should refresh their lookup.

params.token: The token address whose cache entry was invalidated.

TokenCacheUpdated(address,address).details: Signals that the mapping from the token to its corresponding ERC-314 contract      has been set or replaced. Consumers may use this event to update local caches      and react to changes in token-to-ERC314 associations.

params.erc314: The address of the new ERC-314 implementation associated with the token.
params.token: The token address whose cache entry was updated.

addLiquidityAVAX(address,uint256,uint256.details: Adds liquidity to an ERC314 token's AMM with AVAX.

params.amountAVAXMin: The minimum amount of AVAX to add as liquidity
params.amountTokenDesired: The amount of token desired to add as liquidity
params.amountTokenMin: The minimum amount of token to add as liquidity
params.deadline: The timestamp after which the transaction will revert
params.to: The address that will receive the liquidity tokens
params.token: The token address to add liquidity for

returns.amountAVAX: The actual amount of AVAX used
returns.amountToken: The actual amount of token used
returns.liquidity: The amount of liquidity tokens minted

constructor.details: Constructor initializes the router with factory and wrapper factory addresses

params._factory: Address of the BIFKN314 factory contract
params._wrapperFactory: Address of the wrapper factory contract

getAllTokens().details: This function returns a list of all tokens that can be traded through the router,      including both native ERC314 tokens and the original ERC20 tokens that have wrapped versions

getAmountIn(address,uint256,uint256,uint.details: Calculates the input amount required for a given output amount

params.reserveIn: The reserve of the input token
params.reserveOut: The reserve of the output token

getAmountOut(address,uint256,uint256,uin.details: Calculates the output amount for a given input amount

params.reserveIn: The reserve of the input token
params.reserveOut: The reserve of the output token

getAmountsIn(uint256,address[]).details: Calculates the input amounts required for a given output amount along a path, using the optimized path for calculation.

params.path: The array of token addresses representing the swap path

returns.amounts: Array of input/output amounts for each step in the path

getAmountsOut(uint256,address[]).details: Calculates the output amounts for a given input amount along a path, using the optimized path for calculation.

params.path: The array of token addresses representing the swap path

returns.amounts: Array of input/output amounts for each step in the path

getPair(address,address).details: In the BIFKN314 protocol, one of the tokens must be WAVAX.      If neither token is WAVAX, the function returns the zero address.

params.tokenA: The address of the first token in the pair.
params.tokenB: The address of the second token in the pair.

returns._0: The address of the ERC314 token associated with the non-WAVAX token,         or the zero address if neither token is WAVAX.

getReserves(address).details: This function calls the `getReserves` method on the ERC314 token contract associated with the given token.

params.token: The address of the token for which reserves are being queried.

returns.avaxReserve: The amount of AVAX held in reserve.
returns.tokenReserve: The amount of the specified token held in reserve.

invalidateTokenCache(address).details: Deletes the storage entry in tokenToERC314Cache for `token`, forcing subsequent calls that rely on      the cache to recompute or re-fetch the value. This function is restricted by the `onlyOwner` modifier,      and emits a TokenCacheInvalidated(token) event after clearing the cache.      Clearing the cache may increase gas usage on the next operations that require the cached data.

params.token: The token address whose cached ERC-314 information should be removed.

optimizePath(address[]).details: Optimizes a path for the ERC314 ecosystem, where all tokens are paired only with AVAX. Prioritizes most common path patterns for gas efficiency.

params.path: The original path provided by the user

returns._0: optimizedPath The most efficient path for execution

overrideTokenCache(address,address).custom:emits: TokenCacheUpdated Emitted after the cache entry for `token` is updated.
overrideTokenCache(address,address).custom:reverts: InvalidToken(token) Thrown when `token` or `erc314` is the zero address.
overrideTokenCache(address,address).details: Callable only by the contract owner (onlyOwner). Validates inputs and updates the      internal tokenToERC314Cache mapping. Reverts if either `token` or `erc314` is the      zero address. Emits TokenCacheUpdated(token, erc314) on success.

params.erc314: The new ERC-314 implementation address to associate with `token`.
params.token: The token address whose ERC-314 implementation cache will be overridden.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

quote(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Provides a quote given some amount of an asset and pair reserves

returns.amountB: The equivalent amount of asset B

removeLiquidityAVAX(address,uint256,uint.details: Removes liquidity from a token-AVAX pair.

params.amountAVAXMin: The minimum amount of AVAX to receive
params.amountTokenMin: The minimum amount of token to receive
params.deadline: The timestamp after which the transaction will revert
params.liquidity: The amount of liquidity tokens to burn
params.to: The address that will receive the tokens
params.token: The token address to remove liquidity from

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setLegacyTokens(address[],bool).details: Sets the legacy status for multiple tokens at once

params.isLegacy: Boolean value indicating whether the tokens use legacy API
params.tokens: Array of token addresses to mark as legacy

setLegacyWrappers(address[],bool).details: Sets the legacy status for multiple wrappers at once

params.isLegacy: Boolean value indicating whether the wrappers use legacy API
params.wrappers: Array of wrapper addresses to mark as legacy

swapAVAXForEstimatedTokens(uint256,uint2.details: This function performs validations on the input parameters and calculates the required      input amount to achieve the desired output amount. If the estimated input amount exceeds      the maximum allowed input, the transaction reverts.More reliable than swapAvaxForExactTokens when dealing with wrapped tokens

params.amountInMax: The maximum amount of AVAX the user is willing to spend.
params.amountOutDesired: The desired output amount of tokens.
params.amountOutMin: The desired minimum amount of tokens to receive.
params.deadline: The timestamp by which the transaction must be completed.
params.path: An array of token addresses representing the swap path. The first address must be WAVAX,             and the last address must not be WAVAX.
params.to: The address to receive the output tokens.

returns.amounts: An array of token amounts involved in the swap, including the input and output amounts.

swapExactAVAXForTokens(uint256,address[].details: Swaps an exact amount of AVAX for as many tokens as possible.

params.amountOutMin: The minimum amount of output tokens to receive
params.deadline: The timestamp after which the transaction will revert
params.path: The path to follow for the swap (must start with WAVAX)

returns.amounts: The amounts for each step in the path

swapExactTokensForAVAX(uint256,uint256,a.details: Swaps an exact amount of tokens for as much AVAX as possible.

params.amountIn: The amount of input tokens to send
params.amountOutMin: The minimum amount of AVAX to receive
params.deadline: The timestamp after which the transaction will revert
params.path: The path to follow for the swap (must end with WAVAX)

returns.amounts: The amounts for each step in the path

swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256,uint256.details: Swaps an exact amount of input tokens for as many output tokens as possible.

params.amountIn: The amount of input tokens to send
params.amountOutMin: The minimum amount of output tokens to receive
params.deadline: The timestamp after which the transaction will revert
params.path: The path to follow for the swap

returns.amounts: The amounts for each step in the path

swapTokensForEstimatedAVAX(uint256,uint2.custom:throws: ExcessiveInputAmount Thrown if the calculated input amount exceeds `amountInMax`PathMustEndWithAVAX Thrown if the path doesn't end with WAVAXInvalidPath Thrown if the path is invalid (not a direct token-to-AVAX swap)
swapTokensForEstimatedAVAX(uint256,uint2.details: This function calculates the required input amount for the desired AVAX output and reverts if it exceeds `amountInMax`.      It then performs the token swap using the exact input amount.More reliable than swapTokensForExactAVAX when dealing with wrapped tokens

params.amountInMax: The maximum allowable input amount of tokens
params.amountOutDesired: The desired output amount of AVAX.
params.amountOutMin: The desired minimum amount of AVAX to receive
params.deadline: The timestamp by which the transaction must be completed
params.path: An array of token addresses representing the swap path (must end with WAVAX)
params.to: The address to receive the AVAX

returns.amounts: An array of token amounts involved in the swap, including the input and output amounts

swapTokensForEstimatedTokens(uint256,uin.custom:throws: ExcessiveInputAmount Thrown if the calculated input amount exceeds `amountInMax`.InvalidPathLength Thrown if the path length is less than 2.InputCannotBeAVAX Thrown if the first address in the path is not WAVAX.OutputCannotBeAVAX Thrown if the last address in the path is WAVAX.
swapTokensForEstimatedTokens(uint256,uin.details: This function calculates the required input amount for the desired output and reverts if the input exceeds `amountInMax`.      It then performs the token swap using the exact input amount.More reliable than swapTokensForExactTokens when dealing with wrapped tokens

params.amountInMax: The maximum allowable input amount of tokens.
params.amountOutDesired: The desired output amount of tokens.
params.amountOutMin: The desired minimum amount of output tokens.
params.deadline: The timestamp by which the transaction must be completed.
params.path: An array of token addresses representing the swap path.
params.to: The address to receive the output tokens.

returns.amounts: An array of token amounts involved in the swap, including the input and output amounts.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

LEGACY_NATIVE_TO_TOKEN_SELECTOR.details: Constants representing the function selectors for legacy swap functions. LEGACY_NATIVE_TO_TOKEN_SELECTOR:   - Selector for the `swapNativeToToken(uint256,uint256)` function.   - This function is used to swap native currency (e.g., AVAX) to a token. LEGACY_TOKEN_TO_NATIVE_SELECTOR:   - Selector for the `swapTokenToNative(uint256,uint256,uint256)` function.   - This function is used to swap a token to native currency (e.g., AVAX). LEGACY_UNWRAP_SELECTOR:  - Selector for the `unwrap(uint256)` function. - This function is used to unwrap a token to ERC20. LEGACY_WRAP_SELECTOR: - Selector for the `wrap(uint256)` function. - This function is used to wrap a token to ERC314. These selectors are derived using the `keccak256` hash of the function signatures.

_maxApprovals.details: A nested mapping that tracks whether an address has given maximum approval      to another address. The outer mapping key represents the owner address, and      the inner mapping key represents the spender address. The boolean value      indicates whether the spender has maximum approval from the owner.

tokenToERC314Cache.details: A private mapping that acts as a cache to associate a token address with its corresponding ERC314 address. This is used to optimize lookups and reduce redundant computations.
